annotations.summary: used share of ClickHouse's disk default, in %

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS ts, 100 * avgIf(value, metric = 'DiskUsed_default') / avgIf(value, metric = 'DiskTotal_default') AS value FROM system.asynchronous_metric_log WHERE metric IN ('DiskUsed_default', 'DiskTotal_default') AND event_time >= {{.start_datetime}} AND event_time < {{.end_datetime}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

description: ClickHouse's disk default, /var/lib/clickhouse, was more than 80 % full on average over the last 10 minutes, as ClickHouse reads it (DiskUsed_default of DiskTotal_default in system.asynchronous_metric_log). It is the filesystem of the node's local-path user volume, for which the kubelet reports no stats. ClickHouse moves its oldest parts to S3 at 90 %; its system log tables stay on this disk.
